weaknesses.title: SYS NUM only parses LAST — string indices need shuttle glue
weaknesses.detail: ARG/ENV indices arrive as strings. SYS NUM does not take a named var; agents must PREPEND "" A; HEAD LAST; NUM (or similar LAST-clobber dance) before INSERTLINE/DROPNTH. Easy to forget and pass 0/garbage.
weaknesses.repro: LET A="2"; cannot SYS NUM A — must load A into LAST first

weaknesses.title: SYS DROP vs SYS DROPNTH name collision risk
weaknesses.detail: SYS DROP n is skip-first-n window (TAKE dual). SYS DROPNTH bag n drops one field by index. Agents writing runbook 'drop step 1' often call DROP and strip the head window instead of index 1. Catalog hints help but aliases still invite mixups.

weaknesses.title: INSERTLINE past end silently appends
weaknesses.detail: INSERTLINE bag 99 x with len=4 succeeds and appends — no soft miss. Off-by-one dest indices hide bugs; only negative index soft-misses (LAST_N=0). Agents cannot distinguish intended append from bad index without pre-check LINES.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses runbook bag newlines
weaknesses.detail: PRINT_JSON book yields 'aXbc' — agents cannot recover stage order from JSON dump; must READ plate file.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits final trailing newline on last stage
weaknesses.detail: cat -A shows last step without $. Harmless for CubalC LINES; shell wc -l undercounts.

weaknesses.title: move/pin are index-identity only — duplicate steps ambiguous
weaknesses.detail: Two identical step tokens: FINDLINE pin hits first only; move by index is correct but agents thinking value-identity can reorder the wrong occurrence.
weaknesses.repro: book with two 'validate' lines; pin validate moves first only

workarounds: PREPEND empty + HEAD + NUM to parse ARG index strings into LAST_N
Prefer DROPNTH/DROPAT for index delete; never DROP for single-field drop
Before INSERTLINE, SYS LINES and clamp dest if strict placement required
PRINT_JSON scalars (depth/idx); keep bag order on STATE plate only
Deduplicate step tokens or always operate by index after list
language_gaps: SYS NUM name — parse a named string var without LAST shuttle
INSERTLINE strict mode (OOR = miss, no silent append)
PRINT_JSON escape newlines in string values
Rename/docs emphasis DROP window vs DROPNTH index
Atomic move form (drop+insert with index adjust built-in)
